decls.name: theorem_1_1_unit_distance

paper_span.quote: There exists an absolute constant \(\delta>0\) and infinitely many positive integers \(n\) for which \(\nu(n)\geq n^{1+\delta}\).

decls.rationale: The paper's main theorem. `nuMax n` is the paper's \(\nu(n)\) (maximum unit-distance count over n-point planar sets); the Lean statement `∃ δ > 0, ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, nuMax n ≥ n^(1+δ)` is exactly "an absolute δ > 0 and infinitely many n with ν(n) ≥ n^{1+δ}".
